items.text:
I love the game, but it's simply far too buggy to recommend at this time. 

Expanding your ship? Die of hypoxia! Standing around the station? Blacking out due to high G-force! 
Constant stuttering/lag, sometimes items will just disappear, sometimes saves will just break, sometimes ships will just rotate wildly or disappear and sometimes NPC's will just die for no reason.

EDIT; i've changed to positive, as a lot of bugs are being ironed out, and the UI is actually being improved. although i would still wait until after EA.
items.text_zh:

扩建你的飞船？死于缺氧！在空间站里站着？因高G力而昏过去！
持续卡顿/延迟，有时物品会直接消失，有时存档会直接损坏，有时飞船只会在原地疯狂旋转或消失，有时NPC会无缘无故地死掉。

编辑；我改成好评了，因为很多bug正在被解决，UI也确实在改进。不过我仍然会等到抢先体验结束之后再说。

items.text:
My hours probably speak for themselves.  

Before I get into it - This game is very janky, very early access, and the learning curve can feel like a cliff, especially if you haven't done a more realistic space sim before.  

And with that out of the way, I can gush about all the things I enjoy about Ostranauts.  

Probably first and foremost, it sticks to Neo Scavenger's gritty, ascent/descent of human civilization - High tech, low morals, with humanity having spread throughout the solar system and life generally not being good for the average person.  The lore is remarkably deep, with a great deal of allusion to different settlements, organizations, and stranger things that haven't actually been implemented yet - You'll see most of it in ingame 'datafiles' you retrieve from the wrecks you pick over.  

The gameplay loop as it is also leans into the setting - You're just another shipbreaker, feeble and unfit from a life of neglect living in 0G, and unless you spend precious time ironing out your flaws in character creation, you're just as fragile as anyone else.  As the player, there's some cheesing you can do to be an action hero, but one wrong move (or just getting too tired to fight back, or deciding to do a 10G burn for more then a few seconds) can maim or kill you.  

Speaking of the gameplay, it mostly consists of picking over the bones of derelict ships in Ganymed's boneyard in the current version of the game - You'll start underwater on a mortgage, and you'll have to do whatever it takes to pay off your ship, and likely will be upgrading and retrofitting your ship to better suit your playstyle as you go.  There's a number of other options - Chasing gigs, and with the new beta version, trying to make some money on hauling cargo - But the meat of the game is aboard derelicts and the often-tense moments of navigating the boneyard.

I've probably written more then most people will read, so I'll wrap it up with this - The game oozes character, the setting and the actual gameplay line up, and your progression (as of the latest version) is several-fold - Improving your skills, your ship, and with enough time and money, gradually mitigating and removing the scars that 0G living have left on your body.  It's an exceptionally fresh, close-up take of living in a dystopia science-fiction future, and I'm looking forward to seeing the finished product.
items.text_zh:
我的游戏时长大概已经说明了一切。

在深入之前——这款游戏非常粗糙，非常早期访问，学习曲线感觉像悬崖，尤其是如果你以前没玩过更真实的太空模拟游戏的话。

把这些说完了，我可以滔滔不绝地讲我喜欢Ostranauts的所有地方。

大概首先最重要的是，它延续了Neo Scavenger那种人类文明兴衰的粗粝感——高科技，低道德，人类已经遍布整个太阳系，而普通人的生活通常并不好过。背景设定异常深厚，大量影射了不同的定居点、组织，以及一些尚未实际实装的更奇怪的东西——你会在从你翻找的残骸中获取的游戏内“数据文件”里看到大部分内容。

目前的玩法循环也贴合这个设定——你只是又一个拆船工，因长期在0G环境中被忽视的生活而虚弱不堪，除非你在角色创建时花费宝贵的时间来修正自己的缺陷，否则你和任何人一样脆弱。作为玩家，你可以做一些取巧操作来当动作英雄，但一步走错（或者只是累得无力反击，或者决定进行超过几秒钟的10G加速）就可能让你残废或丧命。

说到玩法，在当前版本中，它主要是在Ganymede的废船场里翻找废弃飞船的残骸——你会背负着抵押贷款在水下开始，必须不惜一切代价还清你的飞船，并且很可能在过程中升级和改装你的飞船以更好地适应你的游玩风格。还有其他一些选择——追任务，以及在新测试版中，尝试靠运货赚点钱——但游戏的核心还是在废弃飞船上，以及在废船场中航行时那些常常紧张的时刻。

我大概写得比大多数人会读的还多，所以我就这样收尾——这款游戏充满个性，设定和实际玩法相互契合，而你的成长（截至最新版本）是多方面的——提升你的技能、你的飞船，并且有足够的时间和金钱，逐渐减轻并消除0G生活在你身体上留下的伤痕。它是对反乌托邦科幻未来生活一种异常新鲜、近距离的呈现，我期待看到成品。

observations.description: 游戏非常笨拙，早期访问阶段
observations.evidence: This game is very janky, very early access
observations.evidence_zh: 这游戏非常粗糙，非常早期访问

items.text:
Game is rough, repetitive and wonky as all get out but it hasn't stopped me from enjoying 20+ hours of it. Getting the hang of things at first takes a bit but once you figure it out you'll be looting derelicts and building your own ship ez pz.

Just watch out for the mystery meat.
And grumpy pirates.
items.text_zh:
游戏粗糙、重复，而且笨拙得不能再笨拙，但这并没有阻止我享受20多个小时的游戏时光。一开始上手需要一点时间，但一旦你搞明白了，你就能轻松地打捞废弃飞船并建造自己的飞船。

只要小心那神秘的肉。
还有脾气暴躁的海盗。
